verdict.rationale: Superpowers' skills are plain SKILL.md folders with frontmatter that are 'shared verbatim by every harness', with no per-harness edits to SKILL.md. A hands-on probe installed a skill through the generic `npx skills` installer and read its frontmatter back cleanly, and the docs say Codex, Copilot CLI and Gemini CLI recognize `~/.agents/skills/`. That shows real cross-vendor portability, but no evidence explicitly claims or verifies conformance to the open Agent Skills specification. missing for 10: explicit statement of Agent Skills spec conformance, validation against the spec's required fields/structure, independent corroboration that the unmodified folders load in non-Anthropic harnesses.

support.subject: As a developer, skills follow the open Agent Skills specification so the same skill folder is valid beyond this one vendor's tooling

citations.quote: Skills (harness-agnostic). Everything in `skills/` is the source of truth, shared verbatim by every harness.
it never reaches into `skills/*/SKILL.md` to swap tool names.
Codex, Copilot CLI, and Gemini CLI all also recognize `~/.agents/skills/` as a cross-runtime alias.
Skills are plain, selectively-installable markdown folders.
